articles.title: Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Breaks His Silence, Says He Would Come Back
articles.summary: Jensen Huang, the co-founder of Nvidia who was recently ousted as CEO after he admitted to having an affair with someone that US intelligence believes could by a spy for China, has now said he is open to returning to the company.
body: In his first public statement since his resignation from Nvidia, Huang told The Wall Street Journal that he is aware of the "outpouring of calls" from Nvidia employees, investors, business partners, and customers for him to come back as CEO. He would come back, if asked.

"If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO," he said.
This statement came a day after a source told CNBC that the Nvidia board is not considering bringing Huang back as CEO.
Huang released his statement on social media, saying, "Thank you to everyone who has shown kindness to my family and me. It means the world to me."

She also had a leading role in Mafia: The Old Country as the character Isabella Torrisi, and now she'll be our scrappy salvager turned space traveler Jun Aslan in Exodus.

articles.title: Star Wars: Andor Creator Wants People to 'Blow Up' AI Data Centers by Voting Against Them
articles.summary: Star Wars writer Tony Gilroy has sounded the alarm over the rising tide of AI slop that he believes is a threat to human-made movies. Speaking to Vanity Fair, Gilroy implored movie fans to vote against the spread of AI data centers — and even joking suggested that the artificial…
body: Gilroy, who co-wrote Star Wars: Rogue One and created its widely-praised spinoff Andor, was speaking at a panel event to promote his new film Behemoth!, which stars Pedro Pascal as a cellist who records Hollywood film scores and begins having an existential crisis.

"People's natural resistance to the robot takeover is clear," Gilroy said regarding the recent surge in AI's capabilities — and the concerns surrounding the technology's cultural, financial, and ecological impact. "I don't know what's going to happen. I really don't. The music scene out here [in Los Angeles] is the coral reef of what's happened. It's been dying out here for the last 15 years... It's grooving a little bit now. I think people want humans."

Ultimately, Gilmore suggested, the only way that the rampant spread of AI creation will be curbed is via a public pushback to the building of more AI data centers, which are currently needed to fuel the rise in computational power that generative AI must gobble.

articles.title: GTA 6 Has A Lot Of Different Bird Species, Here’s How Many
articles.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has a lot of details and depth, including dozens of different bird species for people to find. If you're a birder, you're in for a good time. According to The Guardian, Rockstar confirmed that there are 62 types of birds that players can spot.
body: As PC Gamer reminds us, Florida is home to more than 500 bird types, so GTA 6 will have just a fraction of the different kinds of birds people can find in real Florida. GTA 6 was never going to replicate every single bird, of course.

Some of the birds that are found in Florida, and probably GTA 6 as well, include flamingoes, spoonbills, wood storks, egrets, kites, terns, and scrub jays. Florida is also home to bald eagles, and we'd expect them to show up in GTA 6.
Inclusive of birds, GTA 6 has more than 170 animal types, including cane toads, alligators, manatees, and rhesus macaque monkeys.

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game launches at midnight local time, so it will be playable for people in New Zealand and Australia very soon. You can switch your Xbox region to New Zealand to play early, if that works.

articles.summary: All Elite Wrestling's recent Full Gear event had no shortage of great moments, but Austin Creed stole the show with a move straight out of Street Fighter. body: Looking the worse for wear at King's hands, Creed busted out an NES Power Glove and landed a Shoryuken uppercut that exploded in a shower of sparks, knocking his burly foe flat on his back. The moment quickly went viral, and Creed's team would eventually triumph, emerging as the AEW World Trios Champions.

Creed is no stranger to video games; during his run with WWE, he ran the Up Up Down Down YouTube channel, where he competed with fellow performers in a wide variety of games. Wrestling and video games have formed a symbiotic relationship over the years, with top performers like Kenny Omega referencing games like Street Fighter and Final Fantasy 7 for his signature moves. Video games have also positively influenced professional wrestlers, with top WWE star Roman Reigns saying it's a popular downtime activity with his fellow wrestlers and better than some of the "extracurricular" exploits of previous generations.

articles.title: In the Wake of Jensen Huang Scandal, Nvidia Establishes National Security and Export Control Committee
articles.summary: Last week, Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang stepped down amid a scandal involving multiple affairs and alleged suspected espionage. In the aftermath, Nvidia has created a new oversight committee to make sure the company is complying with trade laws.
body: In order to tighten up the company's weak points in the face of a scandal that may have involved $12 billion in AI chips being funneled into China, according to The Times, the Nvidia Board of Directors today implemented a National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee. This new committee will be let the board have oversight into the company's national security policies and export control compliance.

According to Harvey Jones, chairman of Nvidia's Board, "Nvidia recognizes that advanced silicon technologies and the emergence of artificial and superintelligence present unprecedented challenges for national security. As the world’s leading advanced computing company, Nvidia has both a responsibility and an opportunity to lead the industry in addressing these challenges. We are committed to working constructively with government and industry partners to help establish and advance a robust framework that uses every tool at our disposal to safeguard national security while supporting continued technological innovation."

articles.summary: Netflix first announced it was working on a Magic: The Gathering TV series in 2019, and the project has been trapped in development hell ever since, passed between three different creative teams.
body: “The camera opens on [Chandra], but there’s a lot going on,” he says. “I’m not at liberty to give much away, but it’s not that straightforward.”

Chandra and Ajani are planeswalkers with the power to traverse Magic’s multiverse. The journey to different worlds will be depicted through different animation styles chosen through close collaboration between Netflix, animation studio Digic, and Wizards.

“That sounded super cool to us because when we make the card art, we lean into different artists for different styles,” Forsythe says. “This series takes place across quite a few places, which has been the most joyous thing for me to see. Chandra and Ajani have been part of Magic since 2007, when the first planeswalker cards were printed in Lorwyn, but the Netflix series will also introduce new characters that could eventually show up in the game.

articles.title: PlayStation defeats £2 billion UK lawsuit that alleged Sony forced consumers into "excessive and unfair prices"
articles.summary: Sony has defeated a major £2 billion UK class action lawsuit concerning the price of games on the PlayStation Store (thanks, TheGameBusiness ). The judgment came after a 30-day Competition Appeal Tribunal that took place in London, where PlayStation users claimed Sony had removed "all actual and…
body: The case, brought by Alex Neill, who said he represented roughly 12.2 million gamers, accused Sony of applying "excessive and unfair" pricing on games that appeared on the storefront accessible by PS3, PS4 and PS5 consoles - the PlayStation Store. In a judgment published by the London’s Competition Appeal Tribunal today (17th November), the case was rejected. The judgement noted that market definitions used to define Sony's conduct were "unsafe", and that consumers "would be likely to make informed choices when purchasing consoles" and games on the hardware, too.

"Potential PlayStation console purchasers had both access to sufficient information and an incentive to consider that information in order to make informed purchasing decisions at the console level, especially in the case of high-value users who spend significant amounts in the digital gaming aftermarket," read the judgment.

articles.title: Robert Pattinson’s James Bond Will Be ‘an Assassin,’ Director Says
articles.summary: Director Denis Villeneuve's upcoming James Bond has finally found its 007. On Monday, Amazon MGM Studios announced Robert Pattinson will be donning the tux and wearing the gadget-infused watch as the seventh big-screen Bond.
body: In a new interview with GQ, Villeneuve discussed the qualities that he wants in Bond, and what led him to cast Pattinson. "The first quality is that I need to believe that this man is a killer, because more than a spy, Bond is an assassin," Villeneuve said. "I need that kind of anger deep in the eye. It’s not everybody who has that."

While Pattinson first gained prominence as the sparkly vampire Edward Cullen in the Twilight films, he's since found his indie niche as an A24 superstar with roles in movies like The Drama, Primetime, and Good Time, where he played a small-time criminal. He also proved he has the chops to play a spy/killer in Christopher Nolan's Tenet. In short: dude's got range, and definitely possesses that "anger deep in the eye. Villeneuve continued, saying he wants his Bond to have an "unapologetic panache" and to command every room he steps into.

"Someone that has a lot of sensuality as well and that people are attracted to and that someone who expressed some kind of pleasure, someone who has width, sometime who has dark humor, sometimes that has pleasure into being in deep shit, someone who is not afraid to put his hand in the mud," Villeneuve said.
points: Director Denis Villeneuve's upcoming James Bond has finally found its 007.

articles.summary: Sci-fi role-playing game Exodus continues to play into the Mass Effect comparisons by revealing the female version of its main character Jun, and with studio Archetype referring to her in marketing material as FemJun.
body: If that moniker sounds familiar it's because it is: the female Commander Shepard character in the Mass Effect series was nicknamed FemShep. FemShep became an iconic part of BioWare's iconic series, eventually proving that female leads could front games just as successfully as male leads could, and be every bit as popular.

Is the nickname FemJun too blatant? Possibly. But there's well publicised BioWare pedigree at Archetype Entertainment, in the studio's co-founders and in the people leading the project. Key Mass Effect writer Drew Karpyshyn is in charge of writing Exodus, for example, and the similarities to Mass Effect are something the Exodus team has not been shy about in the past. In the wake of Mass Effect 5 being cancelled and BioWare being closed, they become even more alluring.

articles.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 is the US' best-selling physical game so far this year
articles.summary: The very popular and critically-acclaimed The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has set another record. After selling 5.2m copies in four days and becoming the Switch 2's fastest-selling game, Ocarina of Time has now been revealed to also be a major seller at retail.
body: The remake has sold more than 1m physical copies in the US alone in its launch week (ending 7th November). That's according to Circana analyst Mat Piscatella, who revealed on Bluesky that the record also makes it the first title to surpass 1m physical sales since 2023's Tears of the Kingdom. That is, no other game - from any publisher - has managed to sell over 1m copies in the US within its first week in three years.

While Nintendo games tend to perform better at retail than those from Sony, Xbox or third-party publishers, physical sales in general have been declining in the US. In July, Piscatella revealed that just seven PlayStation games have sold more than 100,000 physical copies up to that point in 2026, and that was after all the backlash to Sony's decision to end physical disc manufacturing by January 2028.

Ocarina of Time's lead of this particular segment likely won't continue, however. That's because, as Piscatella pointed out in a follow-up post, Circana's tracking considers disc-less, code-in-box versions to be physical editions. This means Grand Theft Auto 6 will likely overtake the remake in short order, just as it's expected to break records elsewhere.
points: The very popular and critically-acclaimed The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has set another record.
After selling 5.2m copies in four days and becoming the Switch 2's fastest-selling game, Ocarina of Time has now been revealed to also be a major seller at retail.
